**AC1 — ONE CONTINUOUS RUN, NO FIXTURE STANDING IN FOR THE STEP BEFORE IT.** ⛔ **RE-CUT BY AMENDMENT 1 — the worker makes NO gateway call.** The runner replays Larry's committed verbatim model responses through the real orchestrator, so image prep, region planning, sanity checks, the follow-up decision, the merge and both provenance writers all execute in the worker's own run → reconciliation → provenance persistence → final brand-sorted list → browser-handoff payload, against the disposable Postgres. **The defining test: no step may be handed data a fixture supplied on behalf of the previous step.** If any link still needs a stub, that link is the finding and you say so rather than bridging it.

**AC2 — ALL FOUR PROVENANCE KINDS PERSIST FROM THIS RUN.** Read back from Postgres, **scoped to the shop this run creates** — the cluster is shared and moved under Lane G mid-build (PHOTO rows went 9→17 from another lane). PHOTO rows must cite a region of **this run's own** photograph.

**AC3 — THE RESULT RECONCILES, AND YOU REPORT WHAT IT ACTUALLY IS.** Report observed / accounted / established / resolved / routed / skipped, product count and item count. **⚠️ The established figures over this photograph are 47/47, 39 established, 30 resolved, 9 routed, 39 products / 53 items — but those came from THREE frozen readings. **AC4 — IT REACHES THE BROWSER STAGE.** The run produces a browser-handoff payload, **brand-sorted**, with pack size carried as identity and never multiplied into a purchase quantity (Richmond 16 → **1 pack**). Counts in must equal counts out plus explicitly named exclusions. **Do NOT check out, pay, choose a slot, or touch a live ASDA session** — this produces the payload a runner would pick up, nothing further.

**AC5 — CORROBORATED, NEVER VERIFIED.** One live reading cannot corroborate itself. **If your run produces a single reading, no line may be labelled corroborated either** — say what support it actually has. Warwick's ruling binds every emitted artefact.

**AC6 — THE RESIDUAL GAP IS NAMED, NOT PAPERED OVER.** Live database, live Telegram and the real production trigger are **deliberately out of scope** — the production loop sends queued messages, and firing it would message Mum unprompted. **State in your return exactly which links are now real and which remain unexercised.** That sentence is what Veritas grades and what Warwick reads.
